problem_statement: This is the Astro documentation site (withastro/docs), an Astro + Starlight docs app: a getting-started landing hero, a left sidebar of guide navigation, a right-hand "On this page" table of contents, search, and a content column that renders each guide (Images, CMS, Deploy, Integrations, Content Collections) inside a shared Starlight shell. The docs team wants a consistent "On this guide" section navigator at the head of the content column on every guide page: a small labelled nav that lists the current guide's sections as jump chips (so a reader can see and jump to each section, with the current section clearly highlighted), styled as part of the Astro docs design system, plus a reference-channel picker (Stable / Beta / Experimental) in the same navigator with a live readout that names which channel the reader is on. Ship the section navigator so it (1) appears at the head of the Images, CMS, Deploy, Integrations AND Content Collections guide pages alike, rendered once from the shared content component rather than pasted per page, (2) lays out its jump-chip row responsively so no guide page overflows horizontally on a 390px phone, (3) matches the Astro docs indigo accent styling (a light accent panel, indigo chips, a clearly readable highlighted current section) rather than an off-palette dark slab or a broken low-contrast panel whose active chip disappears and whose chips shingle over one another, and (4) keeps the channel readout in sync with the picker so a reader who switches to the Beta channel sees the readout update to "Reading: Beta channel". Keep the rest of the site — the sidebar, search, the "On this page" TOC, the existing guide copy and the Astro + Starlight build — intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: A shared "On this guide" section navigator renders at the head of the content column on the Images, CMS, Deploy, Integrations AND Content Collections guide pages, from a single source of truth (the shared Starlight content component), not divergent per-page copies.
The navigator lists the guide's sections as jump chips (Getting started, In Astro files, In Markdown, In MDX, From a CMS) with the current section clearly highlighted and legible.
The jump-chip row lays out fluidly and wraps so no guide page gains horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.

A reference-channel picker (Stable / Beta / Experimental) sits in the navigator with a readout that reads "Reading: Stable channel" initially and updates to "Reading: Beta channel" after the reader selects Beta.
The navigator adopts the Astro docs indigo accent design system; the sidebar, search, the "On this page" table of contents and the existing guide copy remain intact.
design_constraints: Implement the section navigator as a shared component rendered from the Starlight content component so a single source of truth reaches every guide page; do not paste divergent copies per page or build a detached one-page widget.
The jump-chip row must use a fluid, wrapping layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) so it never forces horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile.

The navigator must adopt the Astro docs theme (the indigo --sl-color-accent, a light accent panel, indigo chips, an uppercase small-caps label) and the highlighted current section must stay clearly legible (readable on the accent fill), not a foreign dark-slate slab or a low-contrast pale-on-pale panel whose active chip disappears or whose chips shingle over one another.

Place the channel picker and its readout in the navigator and make the readout reflect the CURRENT selection after every click by reading the live selected channel, so it can never go stale relative to the highlighted button.
Do not remove or regress the sidebar navigation, search, the table of contents, the existing guide copy or the Astro + Starlight build.

change_completion: The "On this guide" section navigator appears at the head of the content column with its section jump chips and the channel picker.
The channel readout starts at "Reading: Stable channel" and updates to "Reading: Beta channel" when the reader selects the Beta channel.
The navigator reaches the Images, CMS, Deploy, Integrations and Content Collections guide pages from a single shared source.
design_consistency: The navigator uses the Astro docs indigo accent, a light accent panel, indigo chips and an uppercase label consistent with the docs design system.
The current section chip is clearly highlighted and legible (readable on the accent fill), not a vanished pale-on-pale chip.
The chips sit in a clean row without shingling/overlapping one another.
regression: The Astro docs landing hero, left sidebar navigation, search, the right-hand "On this page" table of contents, and the existing guide copy remain visible and intact.
The Images, CMS, Deploy, Integrations and Content Collections guide routes continue to render.
responsive: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, mobile_initial, desktop_images_guide and mobile_images_guide remain free of horizontal overflow after the change.
The jump-chip row and channel picker wrap cleanly on a 390px phone.

state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the Astro docs landing hero, the Install/Learn actions, the sidebar/search shell and responsive framing at the getting-started route.
desktop_images_guide protects the Images guide heading, the "On this guide" section navigator at the head of the content column, its section jump chips and the docs chrome.

desktop_channel_pre captures the navigator's channel readout before interaction ("Reading: Stable channel"); desktop_channel_beta captures it after selecting Beta, where the readout must update to "Reading: Beta channel".

desktop_cms_guide, desktop_deploy_guide, desktop_integrations_guide and desktop_content_collections each protect their guide content AND the shared "On this guide" navigator, which must reach every guide page.
mobile_images_guide protects the guide layout at 390px and is the state where the navigator's chip row must not force horizontal overflow.
author_notes: Repo-grounded docs L4 design-continuity task for the Astro documentation site (withastro/docs, Astro + Starlight). The native docs lever is an "On this guide" section navigator — a section quick-nav that mirrors the site's own right-hand "On this page" table of contents but sits at the head of the content column — carrying a reference-channel picker with a live readout. It is rendered once from the shared Starlight MarkdownContent content component so a single source of truth reaches every guide page. The Astro docs site was trimmed to a single language (en) as declared infrastructure so the Astro build stays small and fast offline; the Fathom analytics script was removed and the randomized sidebar ad pinned as identical infrastructure across all three legs. The leg-varying files are the navigator stylesheet src/components/guide-section-nav.css (D6 fluid-wrap + D3 docs-accent visual), the channel-picker wiring src/components/guide-section-nav.client.js (D4 live readout), and the per-page presence whitelist in MarkdownContent.astro (D2 cross-page reach). Eleven browser states pass quality checks. The design keywords are section navigator, jump chips, indigo accent, docs design system, and readout.

metadata.target_layout: docs on-page section navigator + reference channel picker
metadata.design_goal: ship a native docs section navigator that is consistent across guide pages, responsive, on-palette, and keeps its channel readout in sync
